Purpose (ἵνα, ὅπως + subjunctive: an arrow to a target) and fear (φοβοῦμαι μή: a shadow ahead)

Sequence of moods: after a primary verb the subjunctive, after a secondary (past) verb the optative

Participle endings by tense and voice: -ων -ουσα -ον, -ας -ασα -αν, -ώς -υῖα -ός, -είς -εῖσα -έν, -μενος -μένη -μενον
Result with ὥστε: infinitive for a natural result, indicative for an actual one
Negatives: οὐ for facts and statements, μή for wishes, commands, conditions and purpose
